answer: According to the Oxford Commission's Harmonising AI paper, under Regulation 1025/2012, European Standards Organisations (ESOs) are required to give SMEs access to standardisation activities for free or at special rates. The paper recommends that education and training, specifically for non-expert AI stakeholders, must be available to facilitate understanding of and participation in ESOs, tailored to a wide variety of stakeholder groups that need to understand the strategic importance of standards and develop the capacity and skills needed to participate effectively in standards organisations.
